cause: The acceptance harness embedded mutable per-run expectations in a single HOST_CONTRACTS entry keyed only by host instead of loading schema-checked immutable contracts keyed by host and pilot identity.
prevention: Keep shared safety invariants in code, move run-specific expectations to declarative contracts keyed by host plus pilot_id, preserve historical contracts, and fail closed on unknown duplicate malformed or drifting records.
summary: A host-only acceptance lookup bound Bean Wiki to one historical red execution, so an internally consistent green replay was rejected by twelve obsolete contract expectations.
title: Pilot acceptance must select an immutable run contract
